title: preCICE tutorials system tests: tests.yaml
description: Test suites that can be triggered by the system tests. Each test suite is a list of tests, i.e., combinations of the cases of a tutorial.

test_suites.description: The available test suites, by name. By convention, test suites follow the name of the respective tutorial or repository, and are sorted alphabetically.

tutorials.description: Tests that use tutorials from this repository.

external.description: Tests that fetch the tutorial from an external git repository or archive.

tutorialTest.description: A test of a tutorial from this repository.

externalTest.description: A test of a tutorial that is sourced from an external git repository or archive.

source.description: Where to fetch an external tutorial from.

type.description: git: clone the repository at the given ref. archive: download and extract a .tar.gz / .zip.

url.description: URL of the git repository or of the archive.

ref.description: Branch or tag to check out (git only).

subdir.description: Subdirectory of the repository or archive that contains the tutorial directory.

path.description: Name of the tutorial directory (as in the path field of its metadata.yaml).

caseCombination.description: Names of the cases (as defined in the metadata.yaml of the tutorial) that are run together, one for each participant.

referenceResult.description: Path to the reference results archive, relative to the repository root.

maxTime.description: Overrides the max-time of the preCICE configuration, to limit the simulated time.

maxTimeWindows.description: Overrides the maximum number of time windows to simulate.

timeout.description: Timeout of this test, in seconds.

tolerance.description: Relative tolerance of the fieldcompare comparison. Defaults to 3e-7.

anyOf.description: Numbers such as 1e-2 are loaded as strings by some YAML parsers.

skipCompare.description: Skip the comparison with the reference results, and only check that the build and the run succeed.

runBefore.description: Shell command to run in the copied tutorial directory before the Docker build.

runAfter.description: Shell command to run in the copied tutorial directory after the simulation and before the comparison.
